goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide standalone RoPE-tail and FP8 KV quantization execution without claiming KV storage, compressor, attention, or runtime-route ownership.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with libdevice-linked rotary and quantization scale math

covered_behavior: rope_tail_kernel position-stride YARN and inverse tail rotation
fp8_kv_quantize_kernel E4M3FN dequantized round trip of only the non-RoPE prefix in 64-wide chunks
ds4_gpu_rope_tail_tensor and ds4_gpu_dsv4_fp8_kv_quantize_tensor launch and shape surfaces
excluded_behavior: raw KV storage and indexer QAT kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

rust_owned_in_this_stage: executable-local cuda-oxide standalone rope_tail_kernel launch proof
position-stride YARN inverse and partial-prefix E4M3FN numeric validation
not_claimed_in_this_stage: raw KV storage or compressor kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal

b300_execution.test_command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 cargo test --locked -p ds4-cuda --features cuda-oxide-backend -- --nocapture
b300_execution.command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 CUDA_OXIDE_BACKEND=/workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/rustc-codegen-cuda/target/debug/librustc_codegen_cuda.so CUDA_OXIDE_LLC=/usr/bin/llc CUDA_OXIDE_VERBOSE=1 cargo run --manifest-path /workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/cargo-oxide/Cargo.toml -- run --features cuda-oxide-kernels --bin ds4-cuda-rope-kv-quantization-smoke
